Lord Mahavira's 2 Holy Sites | What's Special About Kundalpur and Pawapuri?
Planning a trip to the Bihar Jain Circuit? This is your essential Lord Mahavira Travel Guide! Join me on a spiritual and historical journey as we trace the footsteps of the 24th Tirthankara, Lord Mahavira, visiting the two most sacred sites in the Nalanda district: Kundalpur and Pawapuri.
